messages.backup.title: Backups
messages.backup.help: Automatic backups save your library, statistics and settings once every 24 hours while the app is open. Full backups also include managed images and manuals; ROMs, executables, emulators and caches are excluded.

messages.backup.restart: Restart to activate the restored library
messages.backup.confirm: A restored library will be prepared in a new folder and activated after restarting. Your current library is preserved and an additional safety backup is created. Lightweight backups reuse currently available images and manuals; they cannot recover files that no longer exist.

messages.keyboard.title: Keyboard shortcuts (F1)
messages.keyboard.tab: Move between controls; focus stays inside the open dialog.
messages.keyboard.arrows: Navigate games; move focus in the sidebar and menus.
messages.keyboard.range: Extend the game selection from its starting point.
messages.keyboard.focus_only: Move focus between games without changing the selection.
messages.keyboard.select: Select the focused game; hold Ctrl to add or remove it from the selection.
messages.keyboard.ends: Go to the first or last game, or either end of a list or menu.
messages.keyboard.play: Play the focused game; activate the usual action on other controls.
messages.keyboard.edit: Edit the focused game in the library.
messages.keyboard.delete: Remove selected games from the library, with confirmation.
messages.keyboard.select_all: Select all visible games while the library has focus.
messages.keyboard.context: Open the context menu for the focused game or platform.
messages.keyboard.search: Focus Search games and select its text.
messages.keyboard.regions: Cycle between search, platforms, games and the Play button.
messages.keyboard.menu: Focus the top menu; navigate with arrows, Enter and Space.
messages.keyboard.escape: Close or minimize the active window or menu according to its usual behavior.
